reply.text: {"say":"Arms day: triceps open with overhead extensions to hit the long head, two of them, then biceps get the rest of the session.","title":"Arms: Long-Head Triceps","days":[{"name":"Arms","exercises":[{"key":"cable-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":4,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows high, stretch deep behind the head"},{"key":"ez-bar-overhead-triceps-extension","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Keep elbows pointing forward"},{"key":"ez-bar-biceps-curl","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"No swinging, control the lowering"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":14,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Let the arms hang back for the stretch"},{"key":"dumbbell-hammer-curl","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":14,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":""}]}],"unmet":[]}
